# Summary

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Summary`](gmeow-Summary.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Summary>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/provenance`](../../slices/provenance.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A condensed account derived from a source information object (often machine-generated), linked to its source by [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](../properties/gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md). A lossy projection of its source: the source remains canonical and the summary is the reduced view.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Summary`](gmeow-Summary.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a condensed, lossy account derived from a source information object — a machine- or human-written abstract whose source stays canonical and whose lineage must be recoverable.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a verbatim slice of the source text (use [`gmeow:TextExtraction`](gmeow-TextExtraction.md)) and for an independently authored work that merely covers the same topic; a [`Summary`](gmeow-Summary.md) asserts derivation from a specific source.

### How to use

- Type the condensed object as [`gmeow:Summary`](gmeow-Summary.md) and link it to its source with [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](../properties/gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md); record the generating model via [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](../properties/gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md) and the summarization confidence and lossiness on the statement layer.

### Examples

- ex:summary a [`gmeow:Summary`](gmeow-Summary.md); [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](../properties/gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md) ex:report.
